additional_info.subject: ID0437914-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2/R7 313065117119] The device stays at 30% CRM:02919000178
additional_info.body:
Hi Mert, good afternoon. How are you doing?
Is this the correct charger? It's offline since 1 month ago, I would assume it's related to Router 1, are you able to know the condition on-site?
If the charger has the HMI on and it says Charger is out of order, then it must be the Router 1.
If the charger is completely black, I would need to have it come to SCB to understand the root cause, as of now I am unable to since I've searched in the AWS from that last day it was online and couldn't find it.
Let me know your feedback.
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0437914-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2/R7 313065117119] The device stays at 30% CRM:02919000178
additional_info.body:
Hi Francisco,
Since we weren't able to connect to the device, we asked the CPO to check.
We were able to get a response. As you can see in the ticket attachment, the device is stuck at %30.
As you mentioned, the problem seems to be with router 1. We will check the device in the site tomorrow.
BR,

additional_info.subject: Re: ID0437914-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2/R7 313065117119] The device stays at 30% CRM:02919000178
additional_info.body:
Hi Francisco,
When we arrived, the device was turned on, but there was no internet connection. When we checked the IP addresses, there was no problem. There was a connection to the router interface, but the device screen did not display an ID.
We tried to reconfigure the device but it didn't work.
We will try to flash with another Cfast card.
BR,
